description: ATLAS_PACA_ZONE_FLOOD_RISK is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.webservice-energy.org. Map of flood risks (Atlas Zone Inondable validé) extracted from the GIS CARMEN (DREAL - PACA). (. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include IGN, GIS CARMEN DREAL-PACA, Flood risks, MINES ParisTech, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
